title: Opus vs Sonnet
body:
# What I'm seeing
* My terminal says I'm using Opus.
* When I ask the model it says I'm using Opus.
* https://console.anthropic.com/usage shows I'm using Sonnet. 

# What I expected to see
* I'm using opus over on https://console.anthropic.com/usage

# Environment:
darwin, iTerm.app, v1.0.31                                                                                    │

Is this right?
